summary:
Plan of w199 written: 17 accepted requirements; the 12 retired deprecated scenarios and the deprecated r5 researcher outline (which contradicts r129/r133) are removed.
The earlier plan's two questions were answered B and are now rulings: an answering session with neither answer nor question leaves the question for the person, with no r131 question (decision 12); the integrate round's questions stay in its drafts, a missing change list stays r96's error, and an initiative never goes awaiting-answer (decision 9).
Other decisions: the outcome word gates nothing (r133); stage outputs come from 0038's fields, the formulate round's from its committed @r<n> scenarios (r132); the stand-in's DONE defaults deliver each output; faults are recorded under any node's ## Faults, only a work-item turns failed (r128, r86, r89); show() prints this run's faults; r88's wording.
New module scripts/supervise_outputs.py with a CLAUDE.md row; two new step modules.
